text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metering.reconcile.job_stalled.prod — 2 downstream invoice runs blocked, potential customer invoice gaps. Pager: metering-team -> oncall-ingest.

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-89421 — metering.reconcile.job_stalled (auto-notify)

alex (oncall-ingest): Acked. I’m jumping in. First check: consumer group lag + reconciler pod restarts.

maya (billing-eng): FYI seeing multiple customers with 0 token usage for the current billing window in the invoice-preview service. No charges posted yet but if reconcile stays stuck some invoices might be blank.

samir (sre): On it. Running quick health checks. If invoice-send is automatic we should flip hold to avoid sending incorrect bills.

alex (oncall-ingest): Agree — will flip invoice-send hold flag for prod namespaces. Doing that now.

opsbot: Command executed by alex: /feature-flag set invoice_send_enabled=false --env prod --reason "reconcile stall"

jin (platform): Pulling reconciler logs and consumer metrics. I see a spike in consumer lag starting ~00:55 UTC and the reconciler pod restarted twice around 01:02. Possible checkpoint loss.

samir (sre): Can you paste the tail of the reconciler log around the restart?

jin (platform): Logs snippet:

```
2025-09-06T01:01:58Z reconciler-0 ERROR checkpoint-load failed: checkpoint not found for partition 12
2025-09-06T01:02:03Z reconciler-0 WARN consumer-group lag: 120000 msgs behind
2025-09-06T01:02:04Z reconciler-0 INFO performing offset-reset to earliest
2025-09-06T01:02:09Z reconciler-0 INFO reconcile-loop starting (run_id=aa8f)
2025-09-06T01:02:10Z reconciler-0 ERROR fatal: duplicate-dedupe-timeout -> OOM, terminating
```

maya (billing-eng): That explains the 0 token symptom — if reconciler reset to earliest and OOM'd, the reconciliation window might have skipped committing outputs. Customers show 0 because pipeline didn't write aggregates.

alex (oncall-ingest): Mitigation plan: 1) Hold invoice sends (done). 2) Kick manual reconciler backfill with increased memory & smaller batch size. 3) Monitor token delta stream and run a targeted reprocess for affected customer IDs.

samir (sre): I can spin a high-memory reconciler job; recommend enabling the dedupe striped-worker mode to avoid OOM. Also bump Kafka consumer max.poll.records down to 500.

alex (oncall-ingest): Executing manual backfill job now: `/infra/jobs/run reconciler-backfill --from 2025-09-05T23:30Z --to 2025-09-06T01:10Z --workers 8 --dedupe-mode striped`

opsbot: Job queued: reconciler-backfill (job_id: backfill-775). Status: queued -> running.

maya (billing-eng): Creating invoice hold tag for affected customers so billing UI won't auto-send. Adding temporary invoice_hold=true metadata to customer cohorts flagged by preview.

samir (sre): Monitoring consumer groups with kafka-consumer-groups.sh — here's the command I ran:

```
# check lags
kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka-prod:9092 --describe --group reconciler-main
```

samir (sre): Pre-backfill lag: ~1.2M messages. After scaling consumers and reducing batch size lag is trending down to ~350k.

jin (platform): Backfill job progress: 45% processed, reprocessed ~780k messages, writing aggregates to s3-temp then to final store. No errors in the last 15m.

alex (oncall-ingest): Good. Maya — please confirm invoice_preview values are returning to expected ranges for a sample of 10 customers.

maya (billing-eng): Sampling now. 8/10 show non-zero usage now and totals match expected deltas within 2%. Will hold until all look healthy.

samir (sre): Temporary mitigation checklist completed: scaled reconciler pods x3, consumer.max.poll.records=500, dedupe-mode=striped, backfill job running.

alex (oncall-ingest): Pager update: incident severity lowered to P2 for monitoring-only while backfill completes. Keeping invoice-send hold until we get full green and manual QA.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Backfill job backfill-775 report: progress=85% errors=2 (both transient S3 timeouts retried successfully).

jin (platform): Backfill finished. Final validation: token deltas match expected counts for a 1500-customer sample. Committing aggregates to final store, rolling reconciler config back with safety knobs.

maya (billing-eng): Running final billing QA. If all good we'll lift invoice_hold and re-enable invoice_send for prod. ETA 25m.

alex (oncall-ingest): Acknowledge. I'll keep the hold and check for any post-backfill regressions. Moving to handoff to daytime oncall (samir) in 30m.

samir (sre): Will own postmortem. Suspected root cause: reconciler memory regression + dedupe default change earlier this week — follow-up tasks: revert risky config, add memory headroom in autoscaling policy, add checkpoint integrity alerts.

opsbot: Action items created: RT ticket INF-6220 (postmortem + config revert), RT ticket INF-6221 (add checkpoint-failure PagerDuty rule), RT ticket INF-6222 (billing QA checklist).

maya (billing-eng): :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll update impacted customers and billing ops to hold invoices until we confirm.

alex (oncall-ingest): Closing pager for now, will re-open if metrics regress.

pagerduty: Incident PD-89421 acknowledged and resolved (status: monitoring).

incident-bot: Thread pinned to #incidents and assigned to samir for postmortem.

samir (sre): Postmortem owner confirmed. Will draft and share initial notes later today.
